subject: Renewal + midterm capacity bump for CloudWave — alignment & next steps
content:
--- Message 1 (original) ---
From: Carlos Mejia <carlos@cloudwave.ai>
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.ai
Date: Sun, 5 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal + midterm capacity bump — CloudWave ask

Hi Stephanie / Ben,

We're getting close to our renewal window (Nov 15) and need to lock in a mid-contract uplift: roughly +2.5x token capacity for the next 6 months to support a new summarization product we've piloted. Procurement asked I reach out now for pricing and a single amendment so we can co-term to Nov 15.

Key constraints:
- We need predictable per-token pricing during the uplift period (no surprise overages).
- Procurement prefers an amendment that can be signed electronically (DocuSign).
- We may convert 60% of the uplift into the renewal if usage stabilizes — need an option for partial annualization.

Can you share proposed pricing tiers and what kind of credit or short-term discount you can extend for the 6-month uplift? Also a rough timeline for legal to deliver an amendment.

Thanks,
Carlos
Head of Product
CloudWave AI

--- Message 2 (reply) ---
From: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, procurement@cloudwave.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm capacity bump — CloudWave ask

Carlos — thanks for the heads up and congrats on the pilot traction. Short answers up front, then proposed paths: 

TL;DR — we can support a 6-month uplift with a stepped pricing approach and a one-page amendment for co-term. Options below: 

Option A — Short-term uplift (no annualize):
- +2.5x capacity for 6 months
- 18% one-time uplift discount off list per-token rates for the uplift bucket
- Fixed committed bucket to prevent overage surprises
- Amendment + invoice schedule within 5 business days after paperwork

Option B — Conditional annualization (partial):
- Same uplift for 6 months but with a conversion clause: if average monthly usage during months 3–6 >= 70% of the uplift bucket, up to 60% of the uplift converts into renewal capacity at a blended rate (12% discount vs list)
- Amendment will include conversion mechanics and a 30-day notice window to elect conversion

Constraints / asks from our side:
- We need a single procurement contact and PO reference for the amendment (procurement@cloudwave.ai looks good).
- Legal prefers a tracked-change amendment template rather than an entirely new MSA (speeds sign-off).

Ben will follow with a pricing attachment and an estimate. If these options look reasonable I can loop Legal to start the amendment draft.

Best,
Stephanie
Head of Growth Partnerships
Redwood Inference

--- Message 3 (pricing detail) ---
From: ben.carter@redwood.ai
To: Carlos Mejia <carlos@cloudwave.ai>, stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 7 Oct 2025 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm capacity bump — CloudWave ask

Carlos — attaching a short proposal that lays out the pricing math and an illustration of the conversion clause (Cloudwave_Proposal_v3.pdf). High level below: 

- Uplift bucket: +2.5x (measured in committed token-units) for 6 months
- Short-term uplift rate: $0.0019 / token (18% off current list for uplift-only usage)
- If converted per Option B: converted capacity price = blended $0.0021 / token (12% off list) applied to up to 60% of uplift
- Minimum commitment: 50% of uplift must be pre-paid or placed on a short-term invoice
- We can include a single rollback protection: if usage drops below 40% of uplift for two consecutive months, conversion rights expire

Attachments included: Cloudwave_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal with Excel cost table) and a one-page amendment template we typically use. I included suggested language for the conversion checkbox.

Next steps I propose:
1) Procurement confirms PO reference and whether they prefer an upfront invoice or net-30 for the uplift bucket.
2) Stephanie kicks off Legal with the amendment template and we turn around tracked changes within 3 business days.
3) DocuSign link once amendment is final.

Happy to hop on a 20-minute call if you want to walk the numbers.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Cloudwave_Proposal_v3.pdf (proposal), Amendment_Draft.docx (amendment template)

--- Message 4 (internal approval + external close) ---
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai, Carlos Mejia <carlos@cloudwave.ai>
Cc: procurement@cloudwave.ai
Date: Wed, 8 Oct 2025 15:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + midterm capacity bump — CloudWave ask

Thanks team and Carlos — good plan. I approve moving forward with Option B (conditional annualization) subject to two guardrails: 
1) Net effective discount across converted capacity cannot exceed 12% (we've built that into Ben's blended price).
2) Legal to preserve our standard liability & data residency language — no deviations in the amendment without senior legal sign-off.

Stephanie: please ask Legal to issue tracked-change amendment and route to Carlos' procurement address. Ben: once PO terms are confirmed, push the PDF + invoice schedule and I'll countersign the amendment internally.

Carlos — appreciate the quick coordination. If procurement can confirm whether they want upfront prepay for 50% of uplift or net-30, we'll finalize the DocuSign envelope today.

Warmly,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference
